question: Does a market-neutral low-volatility premium (long low-vol coins, short high-vol coins, beta-balanced) earn positive net returns, and does adding it as a fourth equal-risk leg improve the multi-premia blend?
registration_note: Declared 2026-09-28 before any result of this signal on any coin. Parameters are a priori (60-day vol, weekly, quartiles, same as the other legs). Basis was not chosen because funding is derived from it (would duplicate the carry leg); OI history is not available.

signal.score: minus trailing 60-day stdev of daily open-to-open returns, using days strictly before d
signal.portfolio: long lowest-vol quartile, short highest-vol quartile
signal.beta_balance: long and short sides each scaled to unit ex-ante vol (inverse of their average trailing vol), then the book normalised to 1.0x gross

economics.funding: Binance proxy, charged on held weights

samples.confirmation: the 60 multi-premia-untouched-holdout-v1 coins, same window; run once after development

pass_rules.standalone: on BOTH samples: mean > 0, Newey-West t >= 2 (development) and t >= 1.5 (confirmation), Sharpe > 0 in both halves
pass_rules.blend_addition: on BOTH samples: 4-leg equal-risk blend Sharpe > 3-leg blend Sharpe

if_passed: register a forward watch only; no change to multi-premia-blend-v1
